classic.name: Classic
classic.workBreak: 25m focus / 5m break · long break after 4 cycles
classic.blurb: A gentle on-ramp. Short focus blocks keep momentum without intimidation — ideal when you’re spinning up or clearing lighter work.

sprint.name: Sprint
sprint.bestFor: Warm-up, easing into a hard start
sprint.blurb: Tiny intervals to get moving. Use it to break inertia, dabble into a hard task, or rebuild attention after a distraction.

deep.name: Deep
deep.blurb: Longer focus with a real recovery. Good when you already know what you’re doing and need uninterrupted stretch time.

fifty-two-seventeen.blurb: Desk-work rhythm with a generous break. Enough runway for hard problems, then time to stand, stretch, and reset.

ultradian.name: Ultradian
ultradian.blurb: Aligned with natural ultradian cycles. One long immersion, then a proper rest — best for creative deep dives.

flowtime.name: Flowtime
flowtime.workBreak: Count-up until you stop · break ≈ 1/5 of work time
flowtime.blurb: No fixed focus length. Ride the wave while it lasts; Tempura suggests a break proportional to how long you worked.

hybrid.name: Hybrid
hybrid.workBreak: Classic start → optional Flowtime after the first bell
hybrid.blurb: Begin with a fixed focus. When the bell rings, take a break — or keep flowing and let the session turn into Flowtime.

custom.name: Your own
custom.blurb: Bake your own intervals in Settings — name, focus, short break, long break, and how often the long rest lands.
